settings.question: How long does UK delivery take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery takes 3–5 working days and is free on orders over £50 (£3.99 under £50). Express is 1–2 working days for £6.99, and Next Day is £9.99 if you order by 2pm. Orders are processed within 1–2 working days.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Europe is £12.99 (5–10 working days) and the rest of the world is £18.99 (7–14 working days). Import duties and taxes, where applied, are the responsibility of the recipient.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: You've got 30 days from delivery to return unworn, unwashed items with tags attached. Email ride.loamco@gmail.com with your order number and we'll sort you a returns authorisation. UK returns get a prepaid Royal Mail label. Refunds are processed within 5 working days of us receiving your return.

settings.question: How do exchanges work?
settings.answer: Want a different size or colour? Email us before returning and we'll hold stock for you. Exchanges are dispatched the same day we receive your return, with free standard delivery.

settings.question: What is the Crash Replacement Scheme?
settings.answer: Crashed and trashed your kit? We'll replace the same item at 40% off, no questions asked. Submit a claim with a photo of the damage and your order number within 60 days of the crash. One claim per item per 12-month period.

settings.question: How does Loam Co. sizing run?
settings.answer: Our kit is cut for riding — room to move without being baggy. It runs true to size, and every product page has a size guide with garment measurements. Between sizes? We'd say size up for layering, down for a closer fit. Not sure? Email us — we'll help you get it right first time.

settings.question: How do I care for my kit?
settings.answer: Machine wash cold (30°C), skip the fabric softener (it clogs technical fabrics), and hang dry. That's it. Mud washes out — that's the point.

settings.question: Are your products sustainable?
settings.answer: We use recycled fabrics where performance allows, ship plastic-free, and never overstock. No seasonal clearance mountains, no fast fashion, no greenwashing sermon.

settings.question: How do I become a Loam Co. ambassador?
settings.answer: Apply through our ambassadors page. 15% base commission on every sale through your link, no quotas, no exclusivity, no joining fee. We review every application within 7 days.

settings.question: How can I get in touch?
settings.answer: Email ride.loamco@gmail.com or use the contact page. We get back to every message within 48 hours on working days — usually much faster. We actually read the emails.
